svg.title: The ISCC-HUB network
svg.desc: Declarers choose an ISCC-HUB in the HUB-LIST. Each ISCC-HUB sets its own policy and keeps its own public log. Monitors verify the logs over time, and aggregators index many logs for search. No single operator runs the IDP, and anyone can verify every log.

g.aria-label: every ISCC-HUB with its key and address
policy: keys tied to a web domain
No single operator runs the IDP.
Each ISCC-HUB keeps its own log, and anyone can verify it.
